title: How Riffn works | Talk to the agents in your repos hands-free
excerpt: A ~100 KB zero-dependency bridge runs in your repo. Your iPhone reaches it over Tailscale. Riffn's servers are not in the path.
content_html:
How Riffn works

Talk to your repo agent with the phone in your pocket

Riffn is an iOS app that links your iPhone to a coding agent running in a repo on your own computer, over your own Tailscale network. Start a session in the app, lock the phone and put it away: the session stays active in the background, ready for your next spoken turn or a recognised command, while you drive, walk or do chores.

The bridge is public source: @riffn/bridge is a ~100 KB Node helper with zero runtime dependencies, Apache-2.0, published from CI with npm provenance.

The whole path, end to end

Setup, in three steps

  1. Run the bridge inside the repo on your computer

    From the working directory you want to talk to:

    npx @riffn/bridge@0.6.0 init

    Pin the version rather than running a floating npx @riffn/bridge. You are running code that drives an agent on your machine, so pinning means the code you read is the code you run.

    init detects your agent, generates a bearer token, checks Tailscale, prints a pairing QR code and then runs in the foreground.

  2. Connect over Tailscale and pair by QR

    Tailscale runs on both the computer and the phone, signed in to the same tailnet. In Riffn, open Settings → AI Settings → Repo Agent → Link my machine, scan the QR code, give the connection a name and check that it shows Online.

    Nothing is exposed to the public internet: the bridge binds to your tailnet by default and refuses 0.0.0.0 unless you deliberately override it.

  3. Start a session, put the phone away, keep talking

    You start the session in the app. From then on it stays active in the background with the phone locked, ready for your next spoken turn or a recognised command. It works with earbuds and in CarPlay.

    New accounts default to auto-send, which sends a turn after a silence. Most people who think out loud switch to the trigger word instead: say “activate trigger phrase” and from then on nothing is sent until you say “over”, so you can pause to think without being interrupted.

What you have to bring

Claude Code must already be installed and authenticated on your computer, along with Node 18+ and Tailscale. Riffn does not include Claude Code, a model subscription or any API credit, and it does not run a model for you on the repo path — your CLI and your provider account do that, exactly as if you had typed into Claude Code in a terminal.

You can run an OpenAI, GLM or other model on the repo path, but only through the Claude Code harness, pointed at an Anthropic-compatible gateway such as LiteLLM, Z.ai or OpenRouter. That is a deliberate security choice, not a missing feature: direct Codex bridging is disabled by policy because on native Windows, Codex shell subprocesses can bypass file-read denials, so it fails closed rather than pretending to be contained. Routing through the harness keeps every guarantee below in force, because they are enforced on your machine by Claude Code rather than by the model.

Two things to know before you try it: this uses OpenAI API billing — a ChatGPT or Codex subscription does not supply the API key; and LiteLLM is third-party software that holds that key, so keep the proxy local and authenticated.

Switching by voice

You give every agent and model you link a name of your choosing. Give them one-word names and “Switch to Gloria” becomes a three-word command — no menu, no model picker, no touching the phone during the session. Riffn recognises the command on the phone and acts on it there, so the model you are currently talking to never sees it.

SayReachesRunning on
“Switch to Gloria”Claude Code in the main repoYour computer, via the bridge
“Switch to Milo”GPT-OSS-20BYour machine, as a local OpenAI-compatible server
“Switch to Kimi”An agent working in another app repoYour computer, via a second bridge
“Switch to Nina”A custom CLI agentA Mac mini, via a bridge in custom-agent mode

A typical drive: talk to Gloria about a feature, say “Switch to Milo” and send the next turn to the local model, then “Switch to Kimi” to move to the agent in the other repo. Each bridge gets its own port and its own project state, so several can run side by side on one machine.

Every endpoint has to be configured and paired first; a model or agent you have not set up is not available to switch to. Avoid naming a connection ASSISTANT, PROJECTS or RIFFN CLOUD — those are reserved.

Data path

There are two paths, and neither one carries your inference traffic through Riffn’s Worker.

Repo agent

iPhoneRiffn

Tailscaleyour tailnet

@riffn/bridgein your repo

Claude Codeyour CLI, your provider account

Local model

iPhoneRiffn

Tailscaleyour tailnet

Your model serverOllama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM — any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

Outside that path: speech recognition uses Apple’s Speech framework, so pairing Riffn with a local model does not make the whole path local. Account and subscription state is handled by Riffn’s Worker. If you want an end-to-end-local claim, this page is not making one.

The bridge sends the phone only the reply text, job status (step counts and activity categories, never file contents) and a redacted health summary.

Security boundary

This is remote code execution into your machine

That is the honest framing, and it is why the bridge is small enough to read before you run it. It stays on your tailnet, requires a bearer token on every request, and runs the agent read/plan-only by default.

  • Read/plan-only by default. Nothing writes unless you chose otherwise.
  • Write access is enabled only on the computer, never from the phone. A paired phone, or a stolen token, cannot raise its own permissions.
  • Limited mode is two-key armed: you pick it at init on the machine, and you confirm by voice, and then exactly one task may edit files.
  • A snapshot is taken before any write-capable run — the full repo state including uncommitted and untracked files, as a git ref. If the snapshot cannot be taken, the run is refused rather than run unprotected.
  • Shell and Git execution stay blocked. Claude never gets command execution at any tier: no tests, no installs, no commits, no push, no subagents, no MCP tools.
  • Turns are single-flight. A second concurrent turn gets a 429 instead of spawning a second agent against the same directory.
  • No telemetry, no analytics, no crash reporting. Logs stay on your machine and redact the token, prompts, code and paths by default.
  • State lives outside the workspace. Tokens, sessions, snapshots and audit logs are kept under ~/.riffin-bridge/; startup refuses a state directory inside the repo.
  • Zero runtime dependencies (Node built-ins only), published from CI with npm provenance you can verify on the package page.

Edit modes

One operator control, chosen on the machine at init or in the bridge’s .env. It can never be changed from the phone.

ModeWhat a turn may do
disabled (default)Nothing writes, ever. Read and plan only.
limitedChat stays read-only. One voice-confirmed edit task at a time may edit files, snapshot-first. Claude only.
ungatedAny turn may edit files. Enabling it requires typing yes i understand at init; a script or flag cannot arm it.

In limited and ungated, the edit task runs under a PreToolUse hook that Claude Code consults before every tool call: it allows only Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep and web, and denies everything else. File tools are confined to the working directory, environment and secret files cannot be read or written, and missing paths fail closed.

One limit worth stating plainly: the bridge can also front an arbitrary coding-agent CLI in custom-agent mode. It cannot enforce read-only on a tool it did not write — whatever permissions that CLI has, your voice turns have. Configure the tool itself; the bridge reports caps: operator-defined so the app shows the honest state.

What is supported today

Repo agentsClaude Code. OpenAI, GLM and other models are supported on the repo path through the Claude Code harness, pointed at an Anthropic-compatible gateway (LiteLLM, Z.ai, OpenRouter). Direct Codex bridging is disabled by policy for the containment reason above.
Other agentsAny coding-agent CLI in custom-agent mode, with the caveat above. Custom agents are stateless for now.
Local modelsOllama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM and other OpenAI-compatible servers, reached directly — no bridge needed.
PhoneiOS only.
NetworkTailscale is the documented default. HTTPS via tailscale serve is recommended for iOS.
In-carCarPlay is supported.
SessionThe bridge keeps one continuing Claude Code conversation per working directory, resumed each turn and surviving restarts. Long tasks run as background jobs you can ask about by voice.

Requirements and cost

  • Riffn is iOS only. There is no Android or web client.
  • Linking a local model is free, and requires Sign in with Apple.
  • Linking a repo agent requires the Riffn Code plan. Current prices are on the pricing page and in the App Store listing; this page does not repeat a number that would go stale.
  • You bring your own computer, Tailscale setup, agent installation, and any third-party model or agent subscription and API credit. Those are billed by their providers, not by Riffn.

Two next steps

Read the bridge before you run it — that is the point of it being small.

sentences.zh: 开始会话，放下电话，继续通话

blocks.html_en: You start the session in the app. From then on it stays active in the background with the phone locked, ready for your next spoken turn or a recognised command. It works with earbuds and in CarPlay.

sentences.en: You start the session in the app.
sentences.zh: 您在应用程序中启动会话。

sentences.en: From then on it stays active in the background with the phone locked, ready for your next spoken turn or a recognised command.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，它会在手机锁定的情况下在后台保持活动状态，为您的下一个语音回合或识别的命令做好准备。

sentences.en: It works with earbuds and in CarPlay.
sentences.zh: 它可与耳塞配合使用并在 CarPlay 中使用。

blocks.html_en: New accounts default to auto-send, which sends a turn after a silence. Most people who think out loud switch to the trigger word instead: say “activate trigger phrase” and from then on nothing is sent until you say “over”, so you can pause to think without being interrupted.

sentences.en: New accounts default to auto-send, which sends a turn after a silence.
sentences.zh: 新帐户默认为自动发送，静音后轮流发送。

sentences.en: Most people who think out loud switch to the trigger word instead: say “activate trigger phrase” and from then on nothing is sent until you say “over”, so you can pause to think without being interrupted.
sentences.zh: 大多数大声思考的人都会切换到触发词：说“激活触发短语”，从那时起，直到您说“结束”之前，不会发送任何内容，因此您可以停下来思考而不会被打断。

blocks.html_en: What you have to bring

sentences.en: What you have to bring
sentences.zh: 你必须带什么

blocks.html_en: Claude Code must already be installed and authenticated on your computer, along with Node 18+ and Tailscale. Riffn does not include Claude Code, a model subscription or any API credit, and it does not run a model for you on the repo path — your CLI and your provider account do that, exactly as if you had typed into Claude Code in a terminal.

sentences.en: Claude Code must already be installed and authenticated on your computer, along with Node 18+ and Tailscale.
sentences.zh: Claude Code 以及 Node 18+ 和 Tailscale 必须已在您的计算机上安装并经过身份验证。

sentences.en: Riffn does not include Claude Code, a model subscription or any API credit, and it does not run a model for you on the repo path — your CLI and your provider account do that, exactly as if you had typed into Claude Code in a terminal.
sentences.zh: Riffn 不包含 Claude Code、模型订阅或任何 API 积分，并且它不会在存储库路径上为您运行模型 — 您的 CLI 和提供商帐户会执行此操作，就像您在终端中输入 Claude Code 一样。

blocks.html_en: You can run an OpenAI, GLM or other model on the repo path, but only through the Claude Code harness, pointed at an Anthropic-compatible gateway such as LiteLLM, Z.ai or OpenRouter. That is a deliberate security choice, not a missing feature: direct Codex bridging is disabled by policy because on native Windows, Codex shell subprocesses can bypass file-read denials, so it fails closed rather than pretending to be contained. Routing through the harness keeps every guarantee below in force, because they are enforced on your machine by Claude Code rather than by the model.

sentences.en: You can run an OpenAI, GLM or other model on the repo path, but only through the Claude Code harness, pointed at an Anthropic-compatible gateway such as LiteLLM, Z.ai or OpenRouter.
sentences.zh: 您可以在存储库路径上运行 OpenAI、GLM 或其他模型，但只能通过 Claude Code 工具，指向与 Anthropic 兼容的网关，例如 LiteLLM、Z.ai 或 OpenRouter。

sentences.en: That is a deliberate security choice, not a missing feature: direct Codex bridging is disabled by policy because on native Windows, Codex shell subprocesses can bypass file-read denials, so it fails closed rather than pretending to be contained.
sentences.zh: 这是一个经过深思熟虑的安全选择，而不是缺失的功能：直接 Codex 桥接被策略禁用，因为在本机 Windows 上，Codex shell 子进程可以绕过文件读取拒绝，因此它会失败关闭而不是假装被包含。

sentences.en: Routing through the harness keeps every guarantee below in force, because they are enforced on your machine by Claude Code rather than by the model.
sentences.zh: 通过线束进行路由使下面的每项保证都有效，因为它们是由克劳德代码而不是模型在您的机器上强制执行的。

blocks.html_en: Two things to know before you try it: this uses OpenAI API billing — a ChatGPT or Codex subscription does not supply the API key; and LiteLLM is third-party software that holds that key, so keep the proxy local and authenticated.

sentences.en: Two things to know before you try it: this uses OpenAI API billing — a ChatGPT or Codex subscription does not supply the API key; and LiteLLM is third-party software that holds that key, so keep the proxy local and authenticated.
sentences.zh: 在尝试之前需要了解两件事：这使用 OpenAI API 计费 - ChatGPT 或 Codex 订阅不提供 API 密钥； LiteLLM 是保存该密钥的第三方软件，因此请将代理保持在本地并经过身份验证。

blocks.html_en: You give every agent and model you link a name of your choosing. Give them one-word names and “Switch to Gloria” becomes a three-word command — no menu, no model picker, no touching the phone during the session. Riffn recognises the command on the phone and acts on it there, so the model you are currently talking to never sees it.

sentences.en: Give them one-word names and “Switch to Gloria” becomes a three-word command — no menu, no model picker, no touching the phone during the session.
sentences.zh: 给他们一个单词的名字，“切换到格洛丽亚”就变成了一个三个单词的命令——没有菜单，没有模型选择器，在会话期间没有触摸手机。

sentences.en: Riffn recognises the command on the phone and acts on it there, so the model you are currently talking to never sees it.
sentences.zh: Riffn 可以识别手机上的命令并对其进行操作，因此您当前正在交谈的模型永远不会看到它。

blocks.html_en: A typical drive: talk to Gloria about a feature, say “Switch to Milo” and send the next turn to the local model, then “Switch to Kimi” to move to the agent in the other repo. Each bridge gets its own port and its own project state, so several can run side by side on one machine.

blocks.html_en: Outside that path: speech recognition uses Apple’s Speech framework, so pairing Riffn with a local model does not make the whole path local. Account and subscription state is handled by Riffn’s Worker. If you want an end-to-end-local claim, this page is not making one.

sentences.en: The bridge sends the phone only the reply text, job status (step counts and activity categories, never file contents) and a redacted health summary.
sentences.zh: 桥接器仅向手机发送回复文本、工作状态（步数和活动类别，从不文件内容）和经过编辑的健康摘要。

blocks.html_en: Security boundary

sentences.en: Security boundary
sentences.zh: 安全边界

blocks.html_en: This is remote code execution into your machine

sentences.en: This is remote code execution into your machine
sentences.zh: 这是在您的机器中远程执行代码

blocks.html_en: That is the honest framing, and it is why the bridge is small enough to read before you run it. It stays on your tailnet, requires a bearer token on every request, and runs the agent read/plan-only by default.

sentences.en: That is the honest framing, and it is why the bridge is small enough to read before you run it.
sentences.zh: 这是诚实的框架，这就是为什么这座桥足够小，可以在运行之前阅读。

sentences.en: It stays on your tailnet, requires a bearer token on every request, and runs the agent read/plan-only by default.
sentences.zh: 它保留在您的尾网上，每个请求都需要不记名令牌，并且默认情况下以只读/计划方式运行代理。

blocks.html_en: • Read/plan-only by default. Nothing writes unless you chose otherwise.

sentences.en: Read/plan-only by default.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下仅读取/计划。

sentences.en: Nothing writes unless you chose otherwise.
sentences.zh: 除非您另有选择，否则什么都不写。

blocks.html_en: • Write access is enabled only on the computer, never from the phone. A paired phone, or a stolen token, cannot raise its own permissions.

sentences.en: Write access is enabled only on the computer, never from the phone.
sentences.zh: 写访问仅在计算机上启用，而不能在手机上启用。

sentences.en: A paired phone, or a stolen token, cannot raise its own permissions.
sentences.zh: 配对的手机或被盗的令牌无法提升自己的权限。

blocks.html_en: • Limited mode is two-key armed: you pick it at init on the machine, and you confirm by voice, and then exactly one task may edit files.

sentences.en: Limited mode is two-key armed: you pick it at init on the machine, and you confirm by voice, and then exactly one task may edit files.
sentences.zh: 有限模式是两键武装：你在机器上初始化时选择它，然后通过语音确认，然后恰好一个任务可以编辑文件。

blocks.html_en: • A snapshot is taken before any write-capable run — the full repo state including uncommitted and untracked files, as a git ref. If the snapshot cannot be taken, the run is refused rather than run unprotected.

sentences.en: A snapshot is taken before any write-capable run — the full repo state including uncommitted and untracked files, as a git ref.
sentences.zh: 在任何可写运行之前拍摄快照 - 完整的存储库状态，包括未提交和未跟踪的文件，作为 git ref。

sentences.en: If the snapshot cannot be taken, the run is refused rather than run unprotected.
sentences.zh: 如果无法拍摄快照，则运行将被拒绝，而不是不受保护地运行。

blocks.html_en: • Shell and Git execution stay blocked. Claude never gets command execution at any tier: no tests, no installs, no commits, no push, no subagents, no MCP tools.

sentences.en: Shell and Git execution stay blocked.
sentences.zh: Shell 和 Git 执行保持被阻止。

sentences.en: Claude never gets command execution at any tier: no tests, no installs, no commits, no push, no subagents, no MCP tools.
sentences.zh: Claude 从未在任何层执行命令：没有测试、没有安装、没有提交、没有推送、没有子代理、没有 MCP 工具。

blocks.html_en: • Turns are single-flight. A second concurrent turn gets a 429 instead of spawning a second agent against the same directory.

sentences.en: Turns are single-flight.
sentences.zh: 转弯为单程。

sentences.en: A second concurrent turn gets a 429 instead of spawning a second agent against the same directory.
sentences.zh: 第二个并发回合得到 429，而不是针对同一目录生成第二个代理。

blocks.html_en: • No telemetry, no analytics, no crash reporting. Logs stay on your machine and redact the token, prompts, code and paths by default.

sentences.en: No telemetry, no analytics, no crash reporting.
sentences.zh: 没有遥测、没有分析、没有崩溃报告。

sentences.en: Logs stay on your machine and redact the token, prompts, code and paths by default.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下，日志保留在您的计算机上并编辑令牌、提示、代码和路径。

blocks.html_en: • State lives outside the workspace. Tokens, sessions, snapshots and audit logs are kept under ~/.riffin-bridge/; startup refuses a state directory inside the repo.

sentences.en: State lives outside the workspace.
sentences.zh: 状态存在于工作空间之外。

sentences.en: Tokens, sessions, snapshots and audit logs are kept under ~/.riffin-bridge/; startup refuses a state directory inside the repo.
sentences.zh: 令牌、会话、快照和审核日志保存在 ~/.riffin-bridge/ 下；启动拒绝存储库内的状态目录。

blocks.html_en: • Zero runtime dependencies (Node built-ins only), published from CI with npm provenance you can verify on the package page.

sentences.en: Zero runtime dependencies (Node built-ins only), published from CI with npm provenance you can verify on the package page.
sentences.zh: 零运行时依赖性（仅限 Node 内置），从 CI 发布，具有 npm 出处，您可以在包页面上进行验证。

sentences.en: In limited and ungated, the edit task runs under a PreToolUse hook that Claude Code consults before every tool call: it allows only Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep and web, and denies everything else.

sentences.en: File tools are confined to the working directory, environment and secret files cannot be read or written, and missing paths fail closed.
sentences.zh: 文件工具仅限于工作目录、环境和机密文件无法读写，缺失路径无法关闭。

blocks.html_en: One limit worth stating plainly: the bridge can also front an arbitrary coding-agent CLI in custom-agent mode. It cannot enforce read-only on a tool it did not write — whatever permissions that CLI has, your voice turns have. Configure the tool itself; the bridge reports caps: operator-defined so the app shows the honest state.

sentences.zh: 配置工具本身；桥报告上限：操作员定义，因此应用程序显示诚实状态。

content_html_zh:
里夫恩的工作原理

用口袋里的手机与您的回购代理交谈

Riffn 是一款 iOS 应用程序，可通过您自己的 Tailscale 网络将您的 iPhone 连接到在您自己的计算机上的存储库中运行的编码代理。 在应用程序中启动会话，锁定手机并将其收起：会话在后台保持活动状态，为您的下一个语音转弯或识别的命令做好准备，而您开车、走路或做家务时。

该桥是公共源代码：@riffn/bridge 是一个大约 100 KB 的节点助手，具有零运行时依赖性，Apache-2.0，由 CI 发布，出处为 npm。

整个路径，从头到尾

设置，分三步

  1. 在计算机上的存储库内运行桥 从您想要与之交谈的工作目录： npx @riffn/bridge@0.6.0 init 固定版本而不是运行浮动的 npx @riffn/bridge。 您正在运行驱动计算机上代理的代码，因此固定意味着您读取的代码就是您运行的代码。 init 检测您的代理，生成不记名令牌，检查 Tailscale，打印配对二维码，然后在前台运行。
  2. 通过 Tailscale 连接并通过 QR 配对 Tailscale 在计算机和手机上运行，​​登录到同一 tailnet。 在 Riffn 中，打开“设置”→“AI 设置”→“Repo Agent”→“链接我的机器”，扫描二维码，为连接命名并检查它是否显示“在线”。 没有任何内容暴露在公共互联网上：桥默认绑定到您的尾网并拒绝 0.0.0.0，除非您故意覆盖它。
  3. 开始会话，收起手机，继续通话您可以在应用程序中开始会话。 从那时起，它会在手机锁定的情况下在后台保持活动状态，为您的下一个语音回合或识别的命令做好准备。 它可与耳塞配合使用并在 CarPlay 中使用。 新帐户默认为自动发送，静音后轮流发送。 大多数大声思考的人都会切换到触发词：说“激活触发短语”，从那时起，直到您说“结束”之前，不会发送任何内容，因此您可以停下来思考而不会被打断。

你必须带什么

Claude Code 以及 Node 18+ 和 Tailscale 必须已在您的计算机上安装并经过身份验证。 Riffn 不包含 Claude Code、模型订阅或任何 API 积分，并且它不会在存储库路径上为您运行模型 — 您的 CLI 和提供商帐户会执行此操作，就像您在终端中输入 Claude Code 一样。

您可以在存储库路径上运行 OpenAI、GLM 或其他模型，但只能通过 Claude Code 工具，指向与 Anthropic 兼容的网关，例如 LiteLLM、Z.ai 或 OpenRouter。 这是一个经过深思熟虑的安全选择，而不是缺失的功能：直接 Codex 桥接被策略禁用，因为在本机 Windows 上，Codex shell 子进程可以绕过文件读取拒绝，因此它会失败关闭而不是假装被包含。 通过线束进行路由使下面的每项保证都有效，因为它们是由克劳德代码而不是模型在您的机器上强制执行的。

在尝试之前需要了解两件事：这使用 OpenAI API 计费 - ChatGPT 或 Codex 订阅不提供 API 密钥； LiteLLM 是保存该密钥的第三方软件，因此请将代理保持在本地并经过身份验证。

语音切换

您可以为链接的每个经纪人和模特指定一个您选择的名称。 给他们一个单词的名字，“切换到格洛丽亚”就变成了一个三个单词的命令——没有菜单，没有模型选择器，在会话期间没有触摸手机。 Riffn 可以识别手机上的命令并对其进行操作，因此您当前正在交谈的模型永远不会看到它。

Say达到运行于
“切换到格洛丽亚”主仓库中的克劳德代码您的计算机，通过网桥
“切换到米洛”GPT-OSS-20B您的机器，作为本地 OpenAI 兼容服务器
“换成基米”在另一个应用程序存储库中工作的代理您的计算机，通过第二个桥
“切换到妮娜”自定义 CLI 代理Mac mini，通过自定义代理模式下的网桥

典型的驱动：与 Gloria 讨论一项功能，说“切换到 Milo”并将下一个回合发送到本地模型，然后“切换到 Kimi”以移动到另一个存储库中的代理。 每个桥都有自己的端口和项目状态，因此多个桥可以在一台机器上并行运行。

每个端点都必须首先配置和配对；您尚未设置的模型或代理无法切换到。 避免将连接命名为 ASSISTANT、PROJECTS 或 RIFFN CLOUD — 这些是保留的。

数据路径

有两条路径，并且没有一条路径通过 Riffn 的 Worker 传输推理流量。

回购代理

iPhoneRiffn

Tailscale你的尾网

@riffn/bridge 在你的仓库中

Claude Code您的 CLI，您的提供商帐户

本地模型

iPhoneRiffn

Tailscale你的尾网

您的模型服务器Ollama、LM Studio、llama.cpp、vLLM — 任何 OpenAI 兼容端点

在该路径之外：语音识别使用 Apple 的语音框架，因此将 Riffn 与本地模型配对并不会使整个路径成为本地的。 帐户和订阅状态由 Riffn 的 Worker 处理。 如果您想要端到端的本地声明，此页面不会做出此声明。

桥接器仅向手机发送回复文本、工作状态（步数和活动类别，从不文件内容）和经过编辑的健康摘要。

安全边界

这是在您的机器中远程执行代码

这是诚实的框架，这就是为什么这座桥足够小，可以在运行之前阅读。 它保留在您的尾网上，每个请求都需要不记名令牌，并且默认情况下以只读/计划方式运行代理。

  • 默认情况下仅读取/计划。 除非您另有选择，否则什么都不写。
  • 写访问仅在计算机上启用，而不能在手机上启用。 配对的手机或被盗的令牌无法提升自己的权限。
  • 有限模式是两键武装：你在机器上初始化时选择它，然后通过语音确认，然后恰好一个任务可以编辑文件。
  • 在任何可写运行之前拍摄快照 - 完整的存储库状态，包括未提交和未跟踪的文件，作为 git ref。 如果无法拍摄快照，则运行将被拒绝，而不是不受保护地运行。
  • Shell 和 Git 执行保持被阻止。 Claude 从未在任何层执行命令：没有测试、没有安装、没有提交、没有推送、没有子代理、没有 MCP 工具。
  • 转弯为单程。 第二个并发回合得到 429，而不是针对同一目录生成第二个代理。
  • 没有遥测、没有分析、没有崩溃报告。 默认情况下，日志保留在您的计算机上并编辑令牌、提示、代码和路径。
  • 状态存在于工作空间之外。 令牌、会话、快照和审核日志保存在 ~/.riffin-bridge/ 下；启动拒绝存储库内的状态目录。
  • 零运行时依赖性（仅限 Node 内置），从 CI 发布，具有 npm 出处，您可以在包页面上进行验证。

编辑模式

一个操作员控件，在 init 处的机器上或在网桥的 .env 中选择。 它永远无法通过手机更改。

Mode转弯可以做什么
禁用（默认）从来没有写过什么。 仅阅读和计划。
有限的聊天保持只读状态。 一次一个语音确认的编辑任务可以编辑文件，快照优先。 仅限克劳德。
未门控的任何回合都可以编辑文件。 启用它需要在 init 中输入 yes i Understanding;脚本或标志无法武装它。

在有限和非门控中，编辑任务在 PreToolUse 挂钩下运行，Claude Code 在每次工具调用之前都会查阅该挂钩：它只允许读取、编辑、写入、Glob、Grep 和 Web，并拒绝其他所有内容。 文件工具仅限于工作目录、环境和机密文件无法读写，缺失路径无法关闭。

有一个限制值得明确说明：桥接器还可以在自定义代理模式下面向任意编码代理 CLI。 它无法对不是它编写的工具强制执行只读 - 无论 CLI 具有什么权限，您的语音也具有该权限。 配置工具本身；桥报告上限：操作员定义，因此应用程序显示诚实状态。

今天支持什么

回购代理克劳德·代码。 OpenAI、GLM 和其他模型通过 Claude Code 工具在存储库路径上得到支持，指向 Anthropic 兼容网关（LiteLLM、Z.ai、OpenRouter）。 由于上述遏制原因，策略禁用了直接 Codex 桥接。
其他代理自定义代理模式下的任何编码代理 CLI，但有上述警告。 自定义代理目前是无国籍的。
本地型号Ollama、LM Studio、llama.cpp、vLLM 和其他 OpenAI 兼容服务器，直接到达 - 无需桥接。
Phone仅限 iOS。
网络Tailscale 是记录的默认值。 对于 iOS，建议通过 tailscale 服务使用 HTTPS。
In-car支持CarPlay。
会议桥接器在每个工作目录中保留一个连续的克劳德代码对话，每一轮都恢复并幸存重新启动。 长任务作为后台作业运行，您可以通过语音询问。

要求和成本

  • Riffn 仅适用于 iOS。 没有 Android 或 Web 客户端。
  • 链接本地模型是免费的，并且需要使用 Apple 登录。
  • 链接回购代理需要 Riffn 代码计划。 当前价格位于定价页面和 App Store 列表中；此页面不会重复会过时的号码。
  • 您可以携带自己的计算机、Tailscale 设置、代理安装以及任何第三方模型或代理订阅和 API 积分。 这些费用由其提供商计费，而不是由 Riffn 计费。
